name: Ivy and Blue
source:
Ivy & Blue is a short, kinetic novel (i.e no choices, one ending) that follows the budding relationship between potential friends. 

[From [url=https://neeka-of-obp.itch.io/ivy-and-blue]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Ivy & Blue》是一部短篇无选项视觉小说，即没有选项、只有一个结局，讲述两个有望成为朋友的人之间，逐渐萌芽的关系。

[摘自[url=https://neeka-of-obp.itch.io/ivy-and-blue]Itch.io[/url]]
